note: Clothing and equipment (Items refill 11, job 92 design; layers M001-T11, 12 Nov 2026, master DYNASTY_MASTER_ITEMS.md s3.8 merged layer model). An item of kind clothing or gear names its body `slot` (one of `slots`) and its `wear_layer` (one of that slot's `layers`, inside to outside; a row without one takes the slot's first layer). Each slot-and-layer pair holds one piece, so a shirt goes under mail and a cloak over armour, but two cloaks, or a coat and a cloak (both body outer), are never worn at once. `spans` names more slots the piece fills at its own layer (a Dress fills body base and legs base). What a character wears is one entry per `worn` position ("slot:layer"), in that order: saved as `worn` in characters.json and sent as worn(numbers, insts) (protocol 107). The first eight positions are the eight slots of protocols 104-106 (head, body, legs, feet, hands, back, outer, waist), so an older save loads into them unchanged: each piece into its slot's base layer, and `outer` into the body's outer layer. New positions are only ever appended. Use on a clothing or gear item in the pack puts it on (ACT_WEAR; the pieces it displaces go back to the pack, and a pack without room for them refuses); the Tab screen takes each piece off (ACT_UNWEAR a = worn position). Clothing `warmth` is the 0..1 share of body heat a piece keeps, combined per slot with diminishing returns (warmth.json layer_keep) and capped by max_insulation; its `fabric` (warmth.json fabrics) sets how it behaves wet, in heat and in rain. Gear `carry_bonus_kg`: a worn backpack raises what the body can carry. Worn pieces stay on through death.
